title: Chocolate Peanut Squares
description: A no-bake traybake of dark chocolate, roasted peanuts and pitted dates. Sweet, nutty and surprisingly good for you.
steps: Chop the chocolate into small pieces. Put the peanuts and dates in a food processor and pulse until crumbly. Add 40g of the chopped chocolate and pulse to combine.
Line a 25cm square baking tray with greaseproof paper, tip in the mixture and smooth the top with a palette knife.
Melt the remaining chocolate and pour over the mixture. Smooth the top with a warmed palette knife.
Cover with cling film and refrigerate for 2–3 hours until firm. Cut into squares to serve.
